entities.summary: Manius Otacilius Crassus was a Roman statesman and general of Samnite origins who served during the middle era of the Roman Republic. He was one of the two consuls of 263 BCE, serving with Manius Valerius Maximus Corvinus Messalla. During their consulship they fought in the First Punic War on Sicily. Their first campaign was against Syracuse; Hieron of Syracuse negotiated terms. They then marched against the Carthaginians; receiving the surrender of several Greek communities who were previously aligned with Carthage.
